scope: unweighted pion_sector/pipS5o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 425 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. 27 empty histograms are N/A, including (3,4), (3,5), (4,7), (4,8).
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 19 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 3 5 9 10 13 14 15 16 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 19 improved. Worst (10,23) 8.12 to 1.56. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 425 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (15,15) B -0.392 beside neighbor 0.019; (10,17) B -0.293 beside neighbor -0.483; (1,13) B -0.332 beside neighbor -0.489.
unresolved: The best three-parameter curve still misses the histogram in (3,29) free_diverged, (8,30) free_diverged. Further guide changes do not help those bins. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes. Pre-existing failed-rule bins were not created by the guide edit and were not counted as improvements: (3,27), (8,25), (8,30), (12,14). They stay out of any RMS.
